name: immigration_enforcement
description: App to measure changes in US immigration enforcement over time.

paragraphs: This app visualizes key datasets related to immigration enforcement in the United States. It was created to help people understand how enforcement levels have changed over time—especially in response to recent policy shifts.
To learn more about the data sources and design choices, check out these blog posts:
features: ICE Detentions: Periodic snapshots of detainee populations held in ICE facilities, sourced from TRAC Reports.
Border Patrol Encounters: Combines year-to-date data from Customs and Border Protection (CBP) with historic data from the Office of Homeland Security Statistics (OHSS).
A Python App for Analyzing Immigration Enforcement Data
Visualizing 25 Years of Border Patrol Data with Python
Visualizing Border Patrol Encounters Under the Second Trump Administration
